outputs: Textual responses with enhanced aesthetics generated by LLMs
The paper focuses on enhancing the aesthetic quality of text generated by LLMs, including aspects such as clarity, layout, uniformity, and coherence.

changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant/duplicate model names and kept only the main evaluated models. Normalized model names to consistent format. Removed verbose output description that was more of a summary than an output description.
Removed redundant metrics (WR vs Win Rate) and consolidated evaluation methods into their base forms. Added MMLU which was used in experiments.
Consolidated redundant methods and normalized naming. The paper uses GPT-4o for both text-based and image-based evaluation with pairwise comparison methodology.

guideline: Human annotators rated generated texts on four dimensions: clarity, layout, uniformity, and coherence using Likert-style rubric
Annotators underwent comprehensive training and calibration process prior to evaluation
Pairwise comparison methodology with win/tie/loss scoring across four evaluation dimensions

overall_notes: The paper focuses on textual aesthetics enhancement for LLM outputs, using both automatic metrics and LLM/human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy and inconsistent naming. The paper evaluates multiple models across different scales and uses comprehensive evaluation methodology including text-based and image-based aesthetic scoring.
